How To Heal From Trauma And Manage Your Anxiety?

The truth is, your daily anxiety might have a surprising connection to your past.  Unlike what you might think, anxiety isn’t just a quirk or a flaw. For many people, it’s a lingering effect of past trauma, a way your body learned to cope with a difficult experience. This article will show you how to heal from trauma and unlock a calmer, more peaceful present, free from the grip of constant anxiety.

Trauma can be anything from a single, overwhelming event to a long-term experience of emotional abandonment or abuse. These experiences leave a lasting mark on your mind and body. When trauma occurs, your nervous system goes into overdrive, flooding your body with stress hormones that prepare you to fight, run away, or freeze in the face of a threat. These are the natural survival responses. 

The problem arises when the trauma remains unhealed. Stuck in this heightened state, your nervous system can become overly sensitive, leaving you feeling constantly on edge and anxious. This is why even seemingly small things can trigger overwhelming anxiety – your body is still reacting as if you’re facing a major threat.

Reach Therapy had us hooked from the get go with their insightful, thoroughly conducted 90-min assessment. So it's double the fun & awe, implementing their tips at home together with Shervin and experiencing their effects first hand.

Also, Reach Therapy further bolstered my conviction that when you seek well-meaning & experienced Indian healthcare professionals, they turn out to be the best in the world. Especially for someone who has witnessed healthcare and sought therapy for my son over our stay in US & UK for years. Let alone abroad, even within our trysts with a few therapists in Bangalore & Mumbai, no one could catch & diagnose Shervin's challenges in as detailed a manner as Dr. Rachana & Dr. Virali did; making it the crème de la crème of quality OT in our relentless search.

Meanwhile, Mrs. Esheta makes for a warm & pleasing presence at the Reception, deftly helping parents and the waiting children alike. So does Anuradha.

Besides the exceptional skills, the good intent & cosy vibe flowing through all levels at Reach Therapy is a world apart from the cold, commercial healthcare spaces we often get to see these days.

This wonderful center lives up to its name, because Shervin's reach has been growing in every direction ever since. I highly, highly recommend Reach Therapy to anyone looking for quality OT. Look no further!
